quote: the first time, looking into solar, gen in general period.
stewart_read: Customer states this is his first exposure to solar at all — a blank slate the rep could shape with curiosity, but the rep immediately pivots to the roof question without expanding.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged the answer thin and not worth expanding given the customer's low energy — but the interest question exists precisely to build the emotional anchor, so this reads as a miss rather than a deliberate skip.
coaching_implication: When a customer says solar is entirely new to them, ask a follow-up (what prompted the interest, what they hope to save) instead of moving straight to roof type.

coaching_implication: Ownership timing (not yet closed vs. title owner) should be explicitly reconciled for the closer's benefit, not brushed past.

quote: I'm I'm just about to start moving. I'm about to move in there on the first.

coaching_implication: Rep should have leaned into this ('getting ahead of it before you even move in — smart move') to build rapport and curiosity rather than a brief 'congratulations.'
